description: Who owns a conversation and where it has got to. `owner_type: "human"` with `status: "human_review"` hands it to a person: the people who can answer as the address are notified, or only `assignee_id` when you name one. Say why in `reason` — it is in their notification. `"agent"` claims a conversation nobody has stepped into. A person replying from the inbox or a mail client takes it over themselves, and `thread.updated` tells you. **While a person has it, you cannot send in it or take it back** (`403 taken_over`); they hand it back.
name: update_thread
title: Hand a conversation to a person
